🇲🇽💧 <u>MEXICO'S WATER WEALTH: 450 BILLION CUBIC METERS A YEAR</u>

Contralínea lays out the numbers: Mexico receives 1.5 trillion cubic meters of rain annually; after evaporation and runoff, some 450 billion m³ of renewable freshwater remain — enough to cover the country's agricultural, industrial and domestic needs many times over. The scarcity is political, not natural: decades of concessions handed a common good to national and foreign corporations while the profit left the country. Water sovereignty is the next battleground.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>US AMBASSADOR BRAGS: ICE HANDED MEXICO 3 MOST-WANTED IN ONE DAY</u>

Ambassador Ronald Johnson took to X to boast that US authorities returned three of Mexico's most-wanted fugitives in a single day — a CJNG member wanted on firearms charges in Guanajuato, a homicide suspect from Zacatecas, and a third for fraud. "Our cooperation, driven by @POTUS @realDonaldTrump and President @ClaudiaShein, sends a clear message to criminals: you will be captured and held accountable."

🇲🇽🏥 <u>SHEINBAUM: NO SOCIAL RIGHTS WITHOUT SOVEREIGNTY</u>

From Ciudad Madero, Tamaulipas, President Sheinbaum inaugurated a new IMSS-Bienestar hospital — a 1-billion-peso facility serving 500,000 people, rescuing a project the neoliberal era started and left to rot. Her message: "There would be no freedom, no well-being, without sovereignty — that's why we defend Mexico's sovereignty just as we defend well-being." In 36 years of neoliberalism, Mexico built just 4,000 public hospital beds. The 4T is rebuilding what privatization gutted.

🏥✊ "Here, care doesn't depend on an affiliation or any ability to pay. No fees, no copays, no conditions of any kind." — Alejandro Svarch, IMSS Bienestar director, Ciudad Madero 538,000 people in the region have no social security. Over 1 billion pesos went into rescuing the hospital: 179 beds (up from under 100), 5 operating rooms (from 2), 20 specialties, the best CT scanner in the region, 100+ new doctors and nurses — and a fully digital clinical control center, a first for Mexico's public health system.

🇲🇽📊 "From 1943 to 1982, 29,000 hospital beds were built. In the next 36 years, only 4,000." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Ciudad Madero, Tamaulipas Sheinbaum's arithmetic on six neoliberal administrations (1982-2018): as population and chronic disease grew, public hospital construction collapsed while private clinics boomed. Her count: 80 abandoned hospitals inherited in 2018 — including this one, started in 2015 and left as a shell.

🏥🇲🇽 "The goal: free healthcare for every Mexican — medicines in every clinic and hospital, doctors, nurses. That's where we're headed." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Ciudad Madero, Tamaulipas Sheinbaum closed her Tamaulipas tour inaugurating the Ciudad Madero IMSS Bienestar General Hospital — the 32nd hospital opened since she took office. She laid out the path to a Universal Health Service: anyone will be able to be treated at IMSS, ISSSTE or IMSS Bienestar, whichever is closest, regardless of affiliation.
